_comment: Verification Suite registry. Extensible: new CAPA closures append a gate entry. See ../references/adding-a-gate.md. Consumers: evaluate-gates.sh (this plugin), verify-before-close.sh (verification-hooks plugin), dev-process SKILL.md Phase 1 Step 5 + Phase 2 reviewer.

gates.title: GATE: Dependencies verified at source
gates.description: Verify external dependency assumptions against actual library source, not wrapper code.
gates.acceptance: Close with VERIFIED: note citing source file paths for each dependency in the spec table.

gates.title: GATE: Plugin installed + invoked in fresh tmux
gates.description: Plugin loads and invokes in a fresh Claude Code session, not just artifact validation.
gates.acceptance: Fresh tmux session id + /plugin install <name>@kyle-plugins output + skill invocation output cited in VERIFIED note.

gates.title: GATE: Pre-mortem filed
gates.description: Multi-step autonomous work requires a pre-mortem card with success, failure, assumptions, verification plan.
gates.acceptance: Card at docs/pre-mortem/YYYY-MM-DD-*.md with success criteria + failure narrative + assumptions + verification plan. VERIFIED note cites card path.
